listing.name: Jet Set Radio Future (Jet Set Radio Future Unleashed)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Upstream runtime package for Jet Set Radio Future Unleashed; use own game files per documented setup, with upstream/player owning installation and runtime replacement. Observed release artifacts are evidence, not operational package selection or Portcove support. Limits: Upstream only: Early playable, not start-to-finish played. Android boot/attract in emulator does not establish physical phone gameplay. Early playable, full playthrough not done. Android boots only emulator not physical phone; iOS user signing and platform package evidence separate. Upstream platforms: macOS ARM64, Windows/Linux x86-64, Android ARM64 and iOS. Android only emulator-tested; iOS user signing required. Original data: Original Xbox JetSetRadioFuture standalone USA NTSC-U disc; not SegaGT combo/Europe/Japan. Exact source revision/hash and BIOS/firmware requirements not stated above remain Unknown in this review. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
